exercises.name: Back Squat
exercises.cue: Brace, sit between your hips, drive the floor away.

exercises.name: Front Squat
exercises.cue: Elbows high, torso tall, knees track over toes.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.cue: Hold the bell at your chest, elbows inside the knees at the bottom.

exercises.name: Leg Press
exercises.cue: Lower until hips want to tuck, then press through mid-foot.

exercises.name: Leg Extension
exercises.cue: Pause at the top, squeeze the quads.

exercises.name: Deadlift
exercises.cue: Wedge in, push the floor away, lock out with glutes not lower back.

exercises.name: Trap Bar Deadlift
exercises.cue: Stand tall in the handles, chest up, drive through the whole foot.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
exercises.cue: Soft knees, push hips back until hamstrings bite, keep the bar close.

exercises.name: Dumbbell RDL
exercises.cue: Dumbbells trace your thighs, hips back, flat back.

exercises.name: Barbell Hip Thrust
exercises.cue: Chin tucked, ribs down, finish with a hard glute squeeze.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Swing
exercises.cue: Hike it back, snap the hips, let the bell float.

exercises.name: Leg Curl
exercises.cue: Control the way down for three seconds.

exercises.name: Back Extension
exercises.cue: Hinge at the hips, finish neutral, don't hyperextend.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
exercises.cue: Back foot on the bench, drop straight down, front heel planted.

exercises.name: Reverse Lunge
exercises.cue: Step back softly, both knees to 90°, drive through the front foot.

exercises.name: Walking Lunge
exercises.cue: Long stride, tall torso, smooth steps.

exercises.name: Step-Up
exercises.cue: Whole foot on the box, stand up without pushing off the back leg.

exercises.name: Single-Leg RDL
exercises.cue: Hips square, reach long through the back heel.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise
exercises.cue: Full stretch at the bottom, pause at the top.

exercises.name: Bench Press
exercises.cue: Shoulder blades pinned, touch low chest, press back over the shoulders.

exercises.name: Incline Bench Press
exercises.cue: 30° incline, bar to upper chest, elbows at 45°.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bench Press
exercises.cue: Let the bells sink deep, press up and slightly in.

exercises.name: Machine Chest Press
exercises.cue: Seat so handles meet mid-chest, smooth tempo.

exercises.name: Push-Up
exercises.cue: Plank tight, chest to the floor, elbows tucked.

exercises.name: Dip
exercises.cue: Slight forward lean, shoulders down, stop when shoulders reach elbows.

exercises.name: Overhead Press
exercises.cue: Squeeze glutes, press the bar back over mid-foot, head through.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
exercises.cue: Neutral-ish grip, press up without flaring the ribs.

exercises.name: Landmine Press
exercises.cue: Shoulder-friendly arc: press up and forward, reach at the top.

exercises.name: Lateral Raise
exercises.cue: Lead with the elbows, stop at shoulder height.

exercises.name: Barbell Row
exercises.cue: Hinge to 45°, pull to the belly button, pause.

exercises.name: Chest-Supported Row
exercises.cue: Chest on the incline bench, drive elbows back, squeeze shoulder blades.

exercises.name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
exercises.cue: Pull the dumbbell to your hip, not your armpit.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row
exercises.cue: Tall chest, pull handle to the ribs, control the return.

exercises.name: Face Pull
exercises.cue: Pull to eye level, thumbs back, elbows high.

exercises.name: Rear Delt Fly
exercises.cue: Hinge forward, sweep arms wide with soft elbows.

exercises.name: Pull-Up
exercises.cue: Dead hang, pull elbows to your back pockets, chin over the bar.

exercises.name: Chin-Up
exercises.cue: Palms facing you, chest to the bar, full lockout below.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.cue: Lean back slightly, pull bar to upper chest, elbows down and in.

exercises.name: Banded Lat Pulldown
exercises.cue: Anchor high, drive elbows to your ribs, slow return.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Curl
exercises.cue: Elbows pinned, supinate as you curl.

exercises.name: Hammer Curl
exercises.cue: Neutral grip, no swing.

exercises.name: Triceps Pushdown
exercises.cue: Elbows by your sides, full lockout.

exercises.name: Overhead Triceps Extension
exercises.cue: Elbows point up, deep stretch behind the head.

exercises.name: Farmer Carry
exercises.cue: Heavy bells, tall posture, short quick steps.

exercises.name: Suitcase Carry
exercises.cue: One bell, don't lean — fight the tilt.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.cue: Squeeze glutes, ribs down, push the floor away.

exercises.name: Side Plank
exercises.cue: Stack the hips, straight line from head to heels.

exercises.name: Dead Bug
exercises.cue: Low back glued to the floor, exhale as you extend.

exercises.name: Pallof Press
exercises.cue: Press straight out and resist the rotation.

exercises.name: Hanging Knee Raise
exercises.cue: Curl the pelvis up, no swinging.

exercises.name: Ab Wheel Rollout
exercises.cue: Hollow body, roll only as far as you can stay tucked.

exercises.name: Cable Woodchop
exercises.cue: Rotate from the hips, arms just guide the cable.

exercises.name: Copenhagen Plank
exercises.cue: Top leg on the bench, lift hips into a straight line.

exercises.name: Easy Bike
exercises.cue: Easy spin, nasal breathing, cadence 80–90.

exercises.name: Easy Row
exercises.cue: Legs, body, arms — smooth and relaxed.

exercises.name: Jump Rope
exercises.cue: Light bounces on the balls of your feet.

exercises.name: Brisk March
exercises.cue: Drive the knees, swing the arms, raise the heart rate.

exercises.name: Cat–Cow
exercises.cue: Move one vertebra at a time with the breath.

exercises.name: World's Greatest Stretch
exercises.cue: Lunge, elbow to instep, rotate and reach to the sky.

exercises.name: 90/90 Hip Switch
exercises.cue: Sit tall, rotate the knees side to side.

exercises.name: Leg Swings
exercises.cue: Front-to-back then side-to-side, growing range.

exercises.name: Knee-to-Wall Ankle Rocks
exercises.cue: Drive the knee past the toes, heel down.

exercises.name: Open Book Rotation
exercises.cue: Side-lying, open the top arm and follow it with your eyes.

exercises.name: Arm Circles
exercises.cue: Small to big circles, both directions.

exercises.name: Band Pass-Throughs
exercises.cue: Wide grip, straight arms over and back.

exercises.name: Inchworm
exercises.cue: Walk the hands out to plank, walk the feet in.

exercises.name: Deep Squat Hold
exercises.cue: Sit into the bottom, elbows prying the knees out.

exercises.name: Neck CARs
exercises.cue: Slow controlled circles, no forcing.

exercises.name: Glute Bridge
exercises.cue: Drive through the heels, squeeze at the top for two seconds.

exercises.name: Band Pull-Apart
exercises.cue: Straight arms, pull the band to the chest.

exercises.name: Scap Push-Up
exercises.cue: Arms locked, let the chest sink then push the floor away.

exercises.name: Bodyweight Squat
exercises.cue: Smooth reps through full range.

exercises.name: Banded Monster Walk
exercises.cue: Band above knees, small steps, stay low.

exercises.name: Couch Stretch
exercises.cue: Rear knee to the wall, squeeze the glute, tall torso.

exercises.name: Pigeon Stretch
exercises.cue: Square the hips and melt forward.

exercises.name: Supine Figure-Four
exercises.cue: Lying on your back, pull the crossed leg in gently.

exercises.name: Supine Hamstring Stretch
exercises.cue: Strap or band around the foot, straight knee.

exercises.name: Adductor Rock-Back
exercises.cue: Kneel with one leg out wide, sit hips back.

exercises.name: Wall Calf Stretch
exercises.cue: Back heel down, knee straight then bent.

exercises.name: Doorway Pec Stretch
exercises.cue: Forearm on the frame, step through gently.

exercises.name: Child's Pose Lat Reach
exercises.cue: Walk the hands to one side, breathe into the ribs.

exercises.name: Cross-Body Shoulder Stretch
exercises.cue: Pull the arm across, keep the shoulder down.

exercises.name: Overhead Triceps Stretch
exercises.cue: Elbow up, hand down the spine.

exercises.name: Biceps Wall Stretch
exercises.cue: Palm on the wall behind you, rotate away.

exercises.name: Child's Pose
exercises.cue: Knees wide, sink the hips to the heels.

exercises.name: Supine Twist
exercises.cue: Knees fall to one side, shoulders stay heavy.

exercises.name: Cobra
exercises.cue: Hips heavy, lift the chest gently.

exercises.name: Easy Walk
exercises.cue: Slow walk, let the heart rate settle.

exercises.name: Bike Flush
exercises.cue: Very light resistance, spin it out.

exercises.name: Box Breathing
exercises.cue: In 4, hold 4, out 4, hold 4.

exercises.name: Crocodile Breathing
exercises.cue: Face down, breathe into your lower back and sides.
